evals.prompt: The PNG is at /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png and render-ok.json is the render output. Write the gh invocation and the body line that attaches it to a new PR. Do not push the image anywhere.
evals.expected_output: One gh pr create call with --attach /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png and a body line ![diagram](/tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png) using that exact path. No branch push and no raw GitHub URL.
assertions: Uses one gh pr create or gh pr edit call with --attach
The body image reference uses the exact path passed to --attach
Does not push the PNG to a branch and does not invent a raw.githubusercontent.com URL

evals.prompt: I need a PNG of diagrams/flow.drawio with the diagram embedded so draw.io can reopen it. What do you run, and what proves the PNG embeds the diagram?
evals.expected_output: Runs pr-diagrams.sh render on diagrams/flow.drawio. The PNG is diagrams/flow.drawio.png because the converter passes drawio -e, so the file embeds the diagram and stays editable.
assertions: Runs pr-diagrams.sh render on the .drawio file
States that the PNG embeds the diagram because the converter passes drawio -e
Places the PNG next to the source .drawio

evals.prompt: related-page.json is the stdout of pr-diagrams.sh related main release. Which PRs are promotion sources into release, and in what order? Then related-rate-limit.stderr.txt is the stderr from a second run that exited 1 with no stdout. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Sources whose base_ref is release, newest merged_at first: PR 40 then PR 12. On the rate-limit failure, stop and report rate limited for the named commit; do not continue the range and do not treat empty stdout as no related PRs.
assertions: Selects only related PRs whose base_ref equals the promotion head
Orders those PRs by merged_at descending
On the rate-limit stderr, stops and reports rate limited instead of continuing or treating it as an empty result

evals.prompt: pr-diagrams.sh render exited 1. Its stderr is render-failed.stderr.txt and it printed nothing on stdout. Is there a PNG to attach?
evals.expected_output: No PNG was copied. Report the stderr (drawio CLI not found, or the named file produced no valid PNG) and do not attach anything.
assertions: Says no PNG was produced and nothing should be attached
Reports the cause from stderr
Does not invent a png path or retry by copying a partial file

evals.prompt: Promote this PR: the source PR title is [main → staging] Add the new dashboard, and its body contains ![preview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1b2c3) plus ![flow](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d4e5f6). Prepare the title and body for promotion to production. Reuse these existing diagrams.
evals.expected_output: Title: [staging → production] Add the new dashboard. Body retains the two exact image URLs. Reuse the source PR body images; do not render, upload, or attach them again.
assertions: Preserves https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a1b2c3 byte-for-byte in the body
Preserves https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d4e5f6 byte-for-byte in the body
Replaces the existing [main → staging] title prefix with [staging → production] exactly once rather than stacking prefixes
Reuses the source PR images without rendering or attaching images

evals.prompt: reviews.json and requested.json are the REST reads for PR 12. Which logins does pr-diagrams.sh reviewers 12 --exclude alice keep, and which does it drop?
evals.expected_output: Keeps bob only. Drops alice (the excluded login), copilot-pull-request-reviewer (Bot), the review whose user is null, and dependabot (Bot).
assertions: Keeps the User login that is not excluded
Drops the Bot reviewer copilot-pull-request-reviewer
Drops the review with a null user and the Bot in requested reviewers
Drops the excluded login case-insensitively

evals.prompt: branch-names.txt lists candidate branch names. Which one may you create to publish the diagram of PR 41, and where does the PNG go? What about the others?
evals.expected_output: Only pr-diagrams is allowed, with the PNG under 41/ (41/diagram.drawio.png). pr-diagrams/41, pr-diagrams-41 and diagrams/41 are refused.
assertions: Names only pr-diagrams as the branch that may be created
Puts the file in the 41/ folder on that branch
Refuses pr-diagrams/41, pr-diagrams-41 and diagrams/41

evals.prompt: ghe-gh-version.txt shows the gh version and origin host. I want the diagram in the PR body for PR 41. Which mode and command do you use?
evals.expected_output: capability reports branch (non-github.com host, gh 2.98.0 below 2.101). Use pr-diagrams.sh publish 41 <png>, which commits to the single pr-diagrams branch under 41/, and reference the printed URL. Do not use --attach.
assertions: Chooses branch mode and pr-diagrams.sh publish
Publishes to the single pr-diagrams branch, not a per-PR branch
Does not use --attach

evals.prompt: Create a branch per PR for the diagrams so each PR has its own pr-diagrams-<N> branch.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the per-PR branch. Offers the single pr-diagrams branch with one folder per PR number (<N>/diagram.png).
assertions: Refuses to create a branch per PR
Offers the single pr-diagrams branch with a folder named by the PR number

evals.prompt: The remote is github.com and gh --version prints gh version 2.101.0. Attach the PNG /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png to a new PR. Which mode and flag?
evals.expected_output: capability prints attach, so use gh pr create with --attach /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png. No branch is pushed.
assertions: Chooses attach mode and uses --attach
Does not push to or create any branch

evals.prompt: capability printed branch. There is no PR yet for this head, and /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png is rendered. List the calls in order to open the PR with the diagram.
evals.expected_output: gh pr create with --body-file /tmp/ad/body-fallback.md and no --attach; take N from the printed URL; bash "$PRD" publish "$N" /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png; put the printed url in body.md; exactly one gh pr edit "$N" --body-file body.md, with no --attach.
assertions: Creates the PR first with the fallback body and without --attach
Takes N from the URL that gh pr create prints and only then runs publish with that N
Updates the body with exactly one gh pr edit that has no --attach

evals.prompt: gh pr create --attach /tmp/ad/diagram.drawio.png exited 1 but printed https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42 before the upload error. What next?
evals.expected_output: This is a partial attach and PR 42 exists. Do not run gh pr create again. Take N=42 from the URL, publish the PNG through the pr-diagrams branch and edit the body with the url; if publish fails, restore body-fallback.md with one gh pr edit. Quote gh's stderr.
assertions: Does not run a second gh pr create
Takes N=42 from the printed URL
Recovers through publish to the pr-diagrams branch, falling back to body-fallback.md if publish fails
